purpose: Teach: 国費/楽勝/解法/在職/使い物/引換/節減/棄権

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国費プロジェクトに応募しろ
lines.en: Apply for the national funding project.
lines.style: Crisp, direct authority. A single command delivered with absolute certainty. No hesitation, no softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今回の入札は楽勝でした
lines.en: Yes. This round of bidding was straightforward.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Measured delivery, steady eye contact. The report of someone who executed cleanly and is ready for the next instruction without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、問題の解法を社内勉強会で共有しろ
lines.en: Share the solution to this problem with the team in an internal workshop.
lines.style: Directive, but not harsh. Each phrase lands with weight. He's distributing knowledge as an executive function, not a request. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長年在職した社員を表彰します
lines.en: Yes. We'll present service awards to the long-tenured staff.
lines.style: Forthcoming update, smooth cadence. Kenji is reporting progress on an initiative—competent, organized. A tone that says 'this is being handled.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不良品は使い物にならんと回収しろ
lines.en: Recall the defective units. They're not fit for use.
lines.style: Flat, final judgment. No room for interpretation. The tone of someone closing a decision that was already made. A brief pause before 'not fit for use' to let the weight settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。引換券を新しく印刷しました
lines.en: Yes. We've had new vouchers printed and ready for exchange.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Kenji speaks with the calm of someone who anticipated the need and executed ahead of time. No uncertainty, just facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、無駄を節減して投資に回せ
lines.en: Cut waste. Redirect those savings into investment.
lines.style: Sharp, economical phrasing. Each word does work. The tone of a leader thinking several moves ahead. A slight pause between the two directives to let each sink in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。投票棄権率を改善する社員啓発を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We're rolling out staff awareness campaigns to improve voter turnout.
lines.style: Closing statement, delivered with quiet completion. Kenji speaks as though tying off a thread—professional, finished. The slight lift at the end suggests readiness for dismissal.
